policy: GENERATED by scripts/crossover/build-arcs.mjs from lib/crossover-roster-data.json. Do not edit by hand: a rebuild overwrites it, and tests/crossover-arcs.test.mjs re-derives the grouping from the roster file. Kept separate from lib/event-data.json so the eight Isekai arcs -- whose names, cast and costPerStage:10 are APK-derived and save-critical (CLAUDE.md rule 12) -- stay byte-identical while these 33 are regenerated.
localNumbers: Stage costs are LOCAL: tier 1 = 10 completions, tier 2 = 20, tier 3 = 30 (the owner halved the planned 20/40/60). 163 stages cost 3,490 completions all told. Arc names, situations and stage titles are written for Everkai; no franchise plot is retold.

events.name: Lanterns Out
events.situation: Every lantern on the east lane goes dark in one night, and nobody will say why.

events.name: The Long Ward
events.situation: The clinic fills after the harvest and the village runs out of people to sit up with it.

events.name: Quiet Quarter
events.situation: The oldest quarter has gone quiet, and quiet is not how it used to be.

events.name: Kiln and Anvil
events.situation: The forge, the kiln and the mill all want the same hour of the same morning.

stages.title: Kites where they should not be

events.name: Night Market
events.situation: The market starts trading after dark, which suits some traders rather too well.

events.name: The Seed Vault
events.situation: The seed store must survive the winter, and something has been getting into it.

events.name: Bells at Dusk
events.situation: The chapel bell is rung at the wrong hour and the whole lane comes out to argue about it.

events.name: The Mended Wall
events.situation: The west wall is patched, badly, and the patch is now the village’s favourite argument.

events.name: Frost on the Well
events.situation: Frost reaches the well and the village discovers how many things depend on one bucket.

events.name: Deep Shaft
events.situation: The old shaft is reopened for stone and immediately needs stronger backs than the village has.

stages.title: The cart out of the mud

events.name: The Signal Fire
events.situation: A fire is lit on the far hill, and nobody agrees on what answering it commits the village to.

events.name: Salt Road
events.situation: The salt road washes out and the village has a fortnight to find another way to the coast.

events.name: The Hollow Lane
events.situation: Half the houses on the hollow lane stand empty, and the other half have questions.

events.name: Paper Lanterns
events.situation: The lantern festival is a week away and nothing that should be ready is ready.

stages.title: Done properly or not at all

events.name: The Cold Kitchen
events.situation: The inn’s kitchen fire goes out in the coldest week of the year.

events.name: Watch Change
events.situation: The watch rota is rewritten and half the village finds itself on a shift it did not expect.

events.name: Last Light
events.situation: The last of the summer light goes, and the village takes stock of who stayed.

events.name: The Cracked Helm
events.situation: A stranger arrives with broken armour, and the village has to decide what to do with him.

stages.title: A better deal than she left with
A faster road than the map

events.name: Two Lanterns
events.situation: Two lanterns are left burning at the crossroads all week, and each one means something different.

events.name: The Library Steps
events.situation: The reading room’s steps crack, and the repair uncovers records older than the village.

stages.title: The far end of the yard

events.name: Old Debts
events.situation: A ledger of unpaid favours turns up, and everyone named in it has an explanation.

events.name: The Toll Ledger
events.situation: The road toll is collected twice in one month, and the second collector is a mystery.

events.name: Dust and Gears
events.situation: The mill, the pump and the airship winch fail in the same fortnight.

events.name: The Council Table
events.situation: The council table is too small for the number of people who now want a seat at it.

events.name: Quiet Signals
events.situation: Messages start arriving that nobody admits to sending.

events.name: The Exile’s Bench
events.situation: The bench by the gate is where the village puts people it has not decided about.

events.name: Workshop Sparks
events.situation: The workshop takes on more work than it can finish and starts recruiting from the lane.

stages.title: The note passed at the back

events.name: The Hidden Landing
events.situation: A second landing stage is found below the cliff, and it has been used recently.

events.name: Rust and Rain
events.situation: A month of rain rusts every hinge, latch and blade the village owns.

events.name: The Foundling Path
events.situation: Children start walking the long path to school alone, and the village decides that will not do.

events.name: Small Hands
events.situation: The smallest hands in the village turn out to be the ones holding it together.
